summary: Reviewed all 486 files of scope LeanPool/@subtrees/0 across 21 project subtrees (ABCExceptions, AgreeToDisagree, BlockSpectralSensitivity, BruhatTits, CenteredMaximal, Computability, DemazureOperatorsLean, FltRegular, FrontierMathOpenHypergraphs, HardSphereNBC, Kurosh, LeanBooleanfun, LeanModularForms, LeanQuantumAlg, OddPrimeValuationDistribution, OrderPQ, SalemTheorem, Sensitivity, SingularModuli, Vlasov, ZetaZeros). Every listed path resolves in the checkout with the byte size given in the brief. A declaration-keyword grep found 18 files with no keyword; all 18 were read in full. 13 are pure module-import indexes (module header, public imports, docstring, `@[expose] public section`); the other 5 carry `open` commands (BruhatTits/Cartan, Graph, Harmonic, Lattice) or `open`/`open scoped`/`variable` (LeanModularForms/Modularforms/Uniformcts.lean), which puts them outside the FILTER-007 unilateral class. Every keyword-matching file under 1200 bytes was also read; 11 are re-export stubs whose keyword hits are only in docstrings (e.g. LeanModularForms/ForMathlib/Bounds.lean, Modularforms/Cotangent.lean, ForMathlib/Hassumunifon.lean, GeneralizedResidueTheory/WindingNumber.lean). Under FILTER-007 and FD-016 these import-only modules stay primary-eligible and receive navigation-import-only ranking, not exclusion: their module paths name the upstream results they re-export, and no end-to-end auxiliary delivery path was verified for this unit. All other sampled files hold real definitions and proofs. Default disposition: retain all 486 files; no exclusion rules.
